notes.title: Quarantine Dev Diary #2: Update and Future
notes.content:
Hello!

Today, we released an update adding a player's guide, bug fixes, and rebalancing to Quarantine! We hope you enjoy the update and would love to hear any feedback you may have. 

Looking into the future, we are going to focus on adding new countries to the game. That being said, we have been secretly working on another project and are currently focusing our energy on getting that project developed. 

What does that mean for the future of this game? We will still be updating this game and adding any feedback we get. We really love the concept of the game and the future potential that this game has to grow. We are already brainstorming version 2 of this game with completely new features and gameplay, but sticking to the overall concept. 

Why are we brainstorming a version 2 instead of updating this game? We love this game and will continue updating it, but we want to bring a new take to this idea that would require an entirely new interface and completely new code base. The concept of the game will be the same, but the gameplay will be completely different and innovative.

When can we expect version 2? We are still trying to decide on whether we will be moving forward with this idea. Currently, we are focused on another project and upon that project's completion we will reevaluate where we are going to take this game and update you.

If you have any questions, feel free to join our discord and ask them.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/rzFG2Kytwx]Join Us On Discord[/url]

Thank you to everyone who played our game! See you in our next dev diary!
